past.title: MCT Spring Fling Mustang Birthday Show | April 18th
past.body:
The Mustang Club of Tidewater’s Annual Spring Fling Mustang Birthday Car Show - All Makes and Models Welcome!!!

Date: Saturday, April 18th, 2026 | 9a-2p

Location: Cavalier Ford Greenbrier - 1515 S. Military Highway, Chesapeake, VA 23320

Click on the header image to see the entire show flyer!

Details:
• This is a Participant's Choice show, with 25 Participant’s Choice awards, and 4 top awards for Best in Show, Dealer’s Choice, Charity's Choice, and Club/Group Participation.
• Open to all years, makes and models of passenger cars, trucks, and motorcycles. Come show us what you have!!!
• This is a family friendly event, so feel free to bring the kids so they can enjoy the show! Bring your cameras!
• There is no charge for spectators, but they must park adjacent to but not in the show field, as directed.
• There will be food vendors on-site and hot dogs & chips provided by Cavalier Ford.
• 50/50 tickets will be sold during the show with winners of various prizes chosen during awards.
• Please be respectful of our host, Cavalier Ford Greenbrier. NO loud music/bass, engine revving, or exhibitions of speed at or departing the show by attendees.

Schedule:
• 9:00 - Registration Opens
• 10:00 - Driver's Meeting / Judging Begins
• 12:00 - Registration Closed
• 12:30 - Judging Ends / Votes Counted
• 1:30 - Car Show Awards Presented and 50/50 Winners announced
• 2:00 - Show Ends

past.title: CCCHR Monthly Meeting | Dec. 23rd
past.body:
Join us for our Monthly Meetings | 4th Tuesday of Every Month

All car club member/representatives are invited to our meetings, which are scheduled the fourth Tuesday of every month. We’ll be discussing what and how the Car Club Council can help and represent the car clubs of the Southside of Hampton Roads and Northern North Carolina. Our goal is to provide a sounding board for all car clubs on the Southside and to be a single voice in support of automotive legislative activities in Virginia and North Carolina. As well as a single location to advertise car club member events on our website calendar. We will also provide a central point for advertising of automotive related facilities and products.

Looking forward to seeing you all at the meeting!

DUES ARE $30.00 FOR ALL CAR CLUBS AND ARE DUE TO THE TREASURER BY MARCH OF EACH YEAR.

Please park behind the building and enter through the Parts department door. For all you guys driving lowered vehicles, beware that the parking lot is full of speed bumps. 1495 South Military Highway, Chesapeake, VA 23320

past.filename: Christmas at Jax.jpg
past.title: Christmas at Jax | Dec. 14th
past.body:
Christmas at Jax

Sunday, December 14th | 11a-4p

Located at Jax Wax 7 Cities | 3200 Dam Neck Rd. Virginia Beach, VA

ITS THE MOST WONDERFUL TIME OF THE YEAR

It’s also been a minute since we’ve had everyone come hang with us at Jax. This year has been a whirlwind of emotions with moving from our Norfolk location to our Virginia Beach location. BUT— every year we have always managed to come together for the holidays. This year will be no different.

If you are a new follower, every year for Christmas we donate to local angel tree candidates from a local school in the 757. Children who don’t get help from larger holiday organizations. Children who come from single parent homes, with a mom or dad trying to just make ends meet. Or grandparents who are raising their grand children, where those same children can’t tell you the last time they have seen their parents. Each angel with their own story, who deserves a Christmas that’s magical.

If you would like to sponsor an angel please DM us.

@sushivice_vb will be out here with some amazing food. So be sure to come on by, donate if you can, grab some stocking stuffers, gift cards, detailing kits, and check out the new shop if you haven’t already. We look forward to seeing everyone.

Much love from your Jax Wax 757 fam.

past.body:
(2nd Thu) Team NvUS: Crews & Brews @ TGB

Thursday, December 11th | 5:30 – 8:00 pm

Located at The Garage Brewery, 1011 Eden Way N., Chesapeake.

Every 2nd Thursday, Designated parking outside and one vehicle parked inside! Team NvUS is a WorldWide Car Club that was established in 2011. The team focuses on maintaining that family atmosphere amongst enthusiasts, all while showcasing quality vehicles at many High Exposure Shows and Charity Shows/Events. All Team NvUS Members are shown with an "NvUS" banner on their car. Virginia 757 Chapter is just one of 4 Chapters in Virginia and also one of over 200 chapters worldwide.

Mark your calendars and join Team Ultraspeed and some of our amazing partners for our 2nd annual charity car show to benefit local non-profit animal rescues in Hampton Roads!

Event registration will go live in June, so hang in there! Car show pre-registration will be $25, day-of registration will be $30. 100% of registrations will be donated to the rescues!
